reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes SimTRL, a bidirectional Mamba trajectory encoder for road-network trajectory representation. Experiments report 11.2x pre-training speedup against multimodal comparison and lower training time, while the efficiency table measures epochs and seconds per epoch. The claimed gain is trajectory-model pre-training, not LLM inference or serving.
title: Towards Efficient and Effective Unimodal Trajectory Representation Learning: A Simple Yet Powerful Approach
